news_cards.title: Bihar Me Hari Mirch Ki Kheti Par Subsidy
bullets: Bihar sarkar dwara hari mirch ki kheti par subsidy di ja rahi hai
Is yojana ke tahat ₹24,000 tak ka anudan diya ja raha hai
Yeh yojana kisanon ko hari mirch ki kheti ke liye protsahit karegi aur unki aay ko badhane mein madad karegi

news_cards.title: Bihar Me Naula Sahyog Shivir
bullets: Naula sahyog shivir me 22 aavedan mile
Is shivir me adhikariyon ne mokhe par kai samasyaon ka nipatara kiya
Yeh shivir logon ko sarkari yojanaon ke bare me jaankari pradan karta hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Banega Steel Hub
bullets: Bihar me 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga
Is nivesh se Bihar steel hub ban jayega
Yeh nivesh Bihar ki arthvyavastha ko badhane mein madad karega

news_cards.title: Mukhyamantri Ka Nirdesh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Bihar sangrahalay sthapna divas par antarrashtriya lok kala pradarshani aayojit karne ka nirdesh diya
Yeh pradarshani Bihar ki lok kala ko badhava degi
Is pradarshani se Bihar ki sanskriti ko pracharit kiya jayega
